To check DESCRIBE yourself, run `python /tmp/describe_check.py`. It covers a bare `DESCRIBE <iri>`, `DESCRIBE ?s WHERE {...}`, `DESCRIBE *`, and a mix of IRI and variable.

I edited `rdflib/graph.py`, `rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py` and `rdflib/plugins/sparql/evaluate.py`.

tool_input.command:
cat > /tmp/t.py <<'EOF'
import rdflib
from rdflib import RDF, Namespace, BNode, Literal
ex = Namespace('http://www.example.org/')
g = rdflib.Graph()
g.add((ex.a, RDF.type, ex.Cl)); g.add((ex.b, ex.p, ex.a)); b=BNode(); g.add((ex.b, ex.q, b)); g.add((b, ex.r, Literal(1)))
g.bind("ex", ex)
for q in ['DESCRIBE <http://www.example.org/a>', 'DESCRIBE ex:a ex:b', 'DESCRIBE ?s WHERE {?s ?p ?o FILTER (?s = <http://www.example.org/a>)}',
 'DESCRIBE ?s ex:b WHERE {?s a ex:Cl}', 'DESCRIBE * WHERE {?s a ex:Cl}', 'DESCRIBE ?s WHERE {?s ?p ?o} LIMIT 1', 'DESCRIBE ?s WHERE {?s ?p ?o} VALUES ?s {ex:a}']:
    r = g.query(q); print(q, r.type, len(r.graph), sorted(r.graph)[:1])
EOF
python /tmp/t.py && python -m pytest test -q -x -k "sparql or cbd or describe" 2>&1 | tail -5
git stash -q && python -m pytest test/test_sparql/test_service.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git stash pop -q && git status --short
